findings.title: CheckinResult crashes to a blank page on an unvalidated 200 check-in payload

evidence.quote: return { ok: true, data: payload as CheckinResponsePayload };

findings.observed: Submitting a 6-character code through /checkin's manual short-code form posts { session_id, code } to the harness's checkin stand-in, gets 200 with a rotating-QR-token body back, and the page white-screens: `pageerror: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'check_in_at')`, document.body.innerText === '', #root empty. There is no error boundary.
findings.expected: Either the response is validated before being cast, or a missing check_in_at renders a generic fallback the way the 'already checked in' branch already does for method='coach' rows with no check_in_at.
findings.proposedScope: Validate the checkin response shape before casting at CheckinResult.tsx:343, or add an error boundary around the result card. Note: StudentHome's own code field does NOT crash on the same response -- this is CheckinResult-specific. This is a harness-shaped input (the harness's `checkin` stand-in has no short-code redemption branch and mints a QR token instead); a real deployed checkin Edge Function would not return this shape for a code POST, so triage should weigh how reachable an equivalently-shaped response is from production before prioritizing.

findings.title: SelfCheckoffDialog is unreachable in the unmodified seed fixtures
findings.observed: On the unmodified seed, Library STEM Night (e0e00000-...-0002) buckets into 'Upcoming' because its session 5e550000-...-0008 is still 'scheduled' (2026-08-23), and Upcoming always passes allowSelfCheckoff={false}. /outreach as student exposes only a 'Hide session details' toggle and an RSVP radiogroup for that event -- no 'Mark attendance' button anywhere in the seed.
findings.expected: This is not a defect in the UI -- the seed simply has no Past outreach event carrying an unrecorded, self-checkoff-eligible session. A spec (or a future seed change) that wants to exercise this surface must arrange one.
findings.proposedScope: No code change proposed. Candidate: add a Past, unrecorded, self-checkoff-eligible outreach session directly to tests/e2e-harness/seed.sql so future specs do not each need their own execAdmin arrangement line.

findings.title: The harness has no stand-in for the checkin-token Edge Function the kiosk calls
findings.observed: Kiosk.tsx's loader invokes the 'checkin-token' Edge Function via the loader at kiosk.ts:369. tests/e2e-harness/server.mjs's EDGE_FUNCTIONS map (lines 474-500) has no such key, so the call 404s with {"message":"harness: no stand-in for Edge Function \"checkin-token\""}. The kiosk page catches this and shows 'QR not available yet.' -- it degrades honestly rather than crashing, and the live tally (e.g. '1 of 3 checked in') still renders correctly from the attendance/students tables, which do go through PostgREST.
findings.expected: N/A for the app -- this is a harness coverage gap, not a production bug. tests/e2e-harness/** is forbidden to this worker's allowed-files list, so filing this as a finding (rather than fixing it) is the correct deliverable here.
findings.proposedScope: Add a 'checkin-token' entry to EDGE_FUNCTIONS in tests/e2e-harness/server.mjs, against the real function's contract in supabase/functions/checkin-token/, if QR-token display coverage is ever wanted from this harness.

findings.title: vite preview binds IPv6-only, causing a silent 180s webServer timeout against the IPv4-polling Playwright config
findings.observed: `npm run preview` alone (no --host flag) binds `vite preview` to [::1] only. playwright.personas.config.ts's webServer readiness check polls 127.0.0.1:4174, which never connects, and the run times out silently after 180s on a fresh checkout with no explanatory error pointing at the mismatch.
findings.expected: The preview server should be reachable on the same address family the config polls, or the config/README should say explicitly that --host 127.0.0.1 is required.
findings.reproduction: npm run preview -- --outDir dist-e2e --port 4174 --strictPort   (binds [::1] only; contrast with --host 127.0.0.1)
findings.proposedScope: Document the required --host 127.0.0.1 flag in tests/e2e-harness/README.md (out of this worker's allowed files) or bake it into the npm script the harness itself invokes.

findings.title: Five pre-existing persona-suite test failures live in files this task may not edit and are not this task's regression

evidence.quote: FINDING 4: an RSVP made on the student home never reaches the database

findings.observed: Baseline before and after this task's changes, reproducible across separate runs: the full persona suite is 21 passed, 5 failed before this task; 27 passed, 5 failed after it (this branch adds 6 tests -- 5 in student-checkin.spec.ts, 1 in coach-checkin.spec.ts -- and the same 5 keep failing), exit 1. coach-meeting.spec.ts:88/:115 fail because 'Volt Legacy 2201' (archived) is no longer offered in the team picker -- stale against shipped archived-team-picker work. student-parent.spec.ts:66 fails because the RSVP control now genuinely writes a fresh rsvps row, contradicting that test's own premise (its module doc claims 'local-only. No Supabase write happens here.'). student-parent.spec.ts:27 and :121 fail on getByText(/\/ 100 h \(/) not found -- the hours-float assertions.
findings.expected: These are pre-existing and out of this task's allowed-files scope (coach-meeting.spec.ts, student-parent.spec.ts are not in GAM-342's allowed-files list). Recorded here per packet instruction rather than chased or fixed.
findings.proposedScope: Separate task: update coach-meeting.spec.ts's team-picker expectations, re-verify and fix/relabel student-parent.spec.ts's RSVP premise (FINDING 4 may itself be stale now that the control writes), and investigate the hours-float selector regression.
